cancellation.disconnect: a socket close is not a task end
cancellation.taskCancel: terminal.cancel_task is what stops an agent

taskIntents.authority: aeroric_protocol::task_intents(); the authoritative enum is core's tasks::service::TaskIntent and a core test pins the two lists together
taskIntents.rule: the save queue carries named intents, never whole-project snapshots (ADR-022); on a rejected write metadata ops replay exactly once and state ops never replay (ADR-026); delete-empty deletes tasks.json (ADR-037)

errorDetail.rule: closed set (Q12): a host builds `detail` from ErrorDetail, so an unregistered key cannot reach the wire without a diff-visible change to that type
errorDetail.whyClosed: frames keep unknown content for forward compatibility, but `detail` is where diagnostics go, and diagnostics get pasted into review evidence and .artifacts logs — from P7-04 real connection strings live nearby

event.openContent: Carried forward unchanged: an addition by a newer host must not fail to parse here.

epoch.note: changes on host restart; seq never carries over

seq.reason: decimal string: JS numbers lose precision past 2^53-1, and a wrapped seq or revision is silent data loss

failure.openContent: Carried forward unchanged: an addition by a newer host must not fail to parse here.

request.openContent: Carried forward unchanged: an addition by a newer host must not fail to parse here.

success.openContent: Carried forward unchanged: an addition by a newer host must not fail to parse here.

ownership.alreadyInUse: must report the lock holder and a safe exit; never kill a PID automatically
ownership.singleWriter: one data directory has exactly one business writer (INV-03)

byteOffset.reason: decimal string: JS numbers lose precision past 2^53-1, and a wrapped seq or revision is silent data loss

generation.reason: decimal string: JS numbers lose precision past 2^53-1, and a wrapped seq or revision is silent data loss

revision.reason: decimal string: JS numbers lose precision past 2^53-1, and a wrapped seq or revision is silent data loss

seq.reason: decimal string: JS numbers lose precision past 2^53-1, and a wrapped seq or revision is silent data loss

resync.bufferTruncation: emit an explicit reset plus truncated flag; do not resume feeding bytes mid escape sequence
resync.startAfterCrash: an uncertain terminal.run_task is reconciled by querying the task's generation, never replayed blindly

terminal.note: raw PTY bytes travel as base64 inside JSON; remote/mobile keep their own binary framing behind an explicit adapter

transport.framing: UTF-8 JSONL, one frame per line

versionPolicy.compatibilityInsideMajor: carried by named capabilities in HostCapabilities, never inferred from a version number — the same rule P7-02 fixed for OS assumptions (ADR-003)
versionPolicy.local: the `v` in every frame must equal constants.protocolVersion exactly; `handshake_allows_peer` is the one implementation of that rule
versionPolicy.mismatch: refuse at the handshake with a stated reason; never degrade to a partial connection
versionPolicy.newMajor: introducing v2 requires its own ADR first: method, topic and enum names become frozen by whatever replaces this
versionPolicy.remote: the relay/mobile protocol is a separate version space: `packages/remote-contracts` declares no version constant today, so any bridge must name the pairs it maps (P8-03) instead of assuming the two move together
